sentences.text: On 2026-11-23, the 2025 RBI pre-payment directions and the 2014 floating-rate pre-payment circular are no longer in force. [R1, R2]
For this individual non-business loan at a Tier 3 UCB, the applicable RBI rule says pre-payment charges, if any, must be as per the UCB’s approved policy. [R7]

Clause 9.3 in the copy states a 3% pre-payment charge on the principal outstanding, but the evidence does not include the UCB’s approved policy needed to confirm whether that charge matches the policy. [E4, E5, E6, R7]
The evidence also shows a conflict between the original agreement clause, which states 2%, and the copy, which states 3%. [E3, E4]

missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force loan agreement copy, the original loan agreement, the retail loan policy definitions, and the applicable RBI rule findings; no approved UCB policy setting the pre-payment charge was provided.
